859ef3fedfeb87c6fe81217e91561ed8532031ca: Col de Porte is a modest, low-key resort, with 3 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where you come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Col de Porte's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Col de Porte's modest altitude, from a base at 1,326 m to a summit at 1,788 m, makes it sensitive to changes in the weather. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow bulletins before you leave is strongly advised. With a day lift pass at just 18€, Col de Porte is one of the most affordable destinations in France. For families on a tight budget, or skiers who want to fit in plenty of days out without breaking the bank, it is a genuine and often overlooked spot. In short, Col de Porte does not rival the giants of skiing, and does not pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
